title: viscaria alpina subsp. americana
intro: Viscaria alpina subsp. americana, commonly known as American Alpine Campions, is a plant species that belongs to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits of reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Viscaria alpina subsp. americana include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential remedy for wounds, infections, and other skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicrin, gentiogenin, and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
